name: Away Lock
description:
Locks the screen when you walk away from the computer.

While the computer is idle it takes a quick look through the camera every few seconds (an IR camera works in the dark too). When nobody is there for two looks in a row, the screen locks. The camera stays off while you type or move the mouse, and while a video or Caffeine keeps the session awake. Frames are never saved.

Needs python3 with OpenCV and dlib, which Howdy (face unlock) already installs; with Howdy it uses the same camera.
